image_description: Two women standing side-by-side wearing black academic gowns and mortarboard caps. The woman on the left holds a white diploma cover and makes a hand gesture; the woman on the right smiles with her hands clasped in front. Both subjects are visible from the waist up.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/hip level, making it impossible to verify if the garment is full-length or reaches the ankles.
Both gowns exhibit clear bilateral symmetry with a vertical center-front opening visible on both subjects.
The fabric hangs loosely and broadly, successfully hiding the specific shape of the torso and arms beneath.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinctive bell-shaped sleeve openings are clearly visible, particularly on the subject to the right, hanging lower than the wrist/hand area.
The vertical lapels or panels framing the center opening are distinct and structurally consistent with academic regalia.
Collars of shirts/blouses are visible at the neckline, indicating the gown is worn over other clothing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears opaque, heavy, and non-reflective (matte), consistent with the expected material properties.
Lighting on the folds shows diffuse reflection rather than specular highlights, confirming a smooth, matte finish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve extensions hang vertically and extend beyond where the wrists are positioned, matching the diagnostic criteria.

artifact_observations.location: Hands of the subject on the left
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers holding the diploma are severely malformed and fused. The thumb and index finger appear to merge into the paper object, and the remaining fingers lack distinct joints and separation, appearing as a melted mass.

artifact_observations.location: Hands of the subject on the right
artifact_observations.reasoning: The clasped hands show significant fusion between fingers. Individual digits are difficult to distinguish, and the anatomy looks compressed and unnatural, lacking clear knuckle definition.

artifact_observations.location: Diploma cover held by left subject
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text/logo on the white cover is illegible gibberish/smudged, typical of AI generation failing to render crisp typography on small objects.
